campus: Viterbo - Campus Riello, Largo dell'Universita. Department: Economics, Engineering, Society and Business Organization (DEIM).
academic_requirements: Bachelor's degree (or three-year university diploma), or another qualification obtained abroad recognized as suitable. Matriculation is subject to verification of curricular requirements, adequate personal preparation, and English language proficiency of at least B2. Per the didactic regulation (Art. 4): at least 36 CFU in basic-science subjects (CHIM/03, CHIM/07, INF/01, ING-INF/05, MAT/03, MAT/05, MAT/07, MAT/08, FIS/01, FIS/07) AND at least 36 CFU in mechanical/industrial-engineering subjects (ING-IND/08, 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17). Missing credits must be made up before the personal-preparation assessment. For degrees obtained abroad or under previous Italian regulations, the Course Council evaluates the applicant's prior academic career to verify curricular requirements. Source: regulation PDF (2023/24 edition, last modified 2024-11-14, still live as of 2026-09-05) at https://www.unitus.it/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Didactic_Regulation_MSc_Mechanical_Engineering.pdf
language_requirements: English at CEFR level B2. If no certificate is held, the department administers its own English-language assessment test before/alongside the interview. No Italian-language requirement, as the programme is delivered entirely in English.
entry_exam_or_test: Mandatory oral interview before a commission of at least 3 faculty members (regulation Art. 4 para. 3), plus a department-administered English test if no certificate is submitted. No TOLC. The interview/assessment also verifies curricular-credit adequacy per the CFU thresholds above.
application_deadline_eu: No programme-specific application deadline is published (rolling admission via online form + interview; all deadline questions must be sent to mechanical.engineering@unitus.it per official page instructions). University-wide enrolment window 2026-08-01 to 2026-12-29 for 1st-year Master's students (academic year 2026/2027), with an extension to 2027-02-28 for January/February graduates.
application_deadline_non_eu: No programme-specific deadline published; same rolling admission process. University enrolment window 2026-08-01 to 2026-12-29 (1st-year Master's, a.y. 2026/2027). Non-EU visa application cutoff at the Italian consulate: 2026-11-30. Universitaly pre-enrolment for non-EU applicants from abroad is open for a.y. 2026/2027 (typically opens April/May).
required_documents: Confirmed: no programme-specific required-documents list exists on any official Mechanical Engineering page (verify_in_deep item resolved - still true as of 2026-09-05). Falling back to the university-wide Universitaly/enrolment document baseline: (1) secondary school diploma (certified copy + apostille/legalization + certified Italian translation, OR CIMEA Statement of Verification); (2) bachelor's degree of at least 3 years (same legalization options); (3) Transcript of Records; (4) Declaration of Value (consulate) OR CIMEA Statement of Comparability OR ARDI Statement of Correspondence; (5) Diploma Supplement (can replace Declaration of Value if legalized); (6) English-language certificate or EMI attestation; (7) admission letter; (8) completed a.y. 2026/2027 application form: https://forms.gle/xAhnhzNUAz9MHVGg9.

tuition_or_fees_link.note: University-wide ISEEUP-based tuition model. Regulations PDF: https://www.unitus.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/TUITION-FEES-AND-CONTRIBUTIONS-REGULATIONS_2026-2027.pdf. Non-EU flat-fee bands (for students not declaring ISEEUP), by country group: EUR 600 / 1,050 / 1,500 / 1,950 per year (see country annex: https://www.unitus.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/All.1_-Paesi_studenti-internazionali_2026_2027.pdf). Simulator: https://www.unitus.it/en/students/fees-and-contributions/tuition-fee-simulator/. Visa financial-means requirement: EUR 10,179.85/year.

source_quotes.quote: To be admitted to the master's degree program in Mechanical Engineering at the University of Tuscia, it is necessary to hold a bachelor's degree or a three-year university diploma, or another qualification obtained abroad that is recognized as suitable. Matriculation is in any case subject to verification of possession of the curricular requirements, adequate personal preparation and language proficiency of at least level B2 English.
Headquarter Campus Riello Largo dell'Universita Viterbo Department Economics, Engineering Society and Business Organization Language English Course lenght 2 years Admission Oral interview

For any information regarding the course of study (deadlines for admission, scholarship timelines, etc.), please write solely to the following email address: mechanical.engineering@unitus.it Any emails sent to different addresses will be ignored and discarded.

The course comprises 120 credits and is divided into 2 years divided into semester-long lecture cycles... the compulsory courses include 51 CFU... The elective courses, for which 45CFU are reserved...
